question: As per the UNDP, the rank of Sri Lanka in the Human Development Index (2022) is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**73/189**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Sri Lanka ranks **73rd out of 189 countries** in the Human Development Index (HDI) for the year 2022, as reported by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).

• The HDI is a composite index measuring average achievement in three basic dimensions of human development: **health, education, and standard of living.**

• Sri Lanka's ranking reflects significant progress in key areas of human development, including **life expectancy, education levels, and Gross National Income (GNI) per capita.**

• This high ranking places Sri Lanka in the category of **high human development** countries, indicating substantial advancement in the well-being of its citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Human Development Index (HDI)**

• The HDI is a summary measure of average achievement in key dimensions of human development: **long and healthy life, being knowledgeable, and having a decent standard of living.**

• It is calculated using indicators such as **life expectancy at birth, mean years of schooling, expected years of schooling, and Gross National Income (GNI) per capita.**

• The HDI aims to shift the focus from economic growth alone to a more comprehensive understanding of human progress.

• Countries are ranked on a scale from 0 to 1, with higher values indicating higher levels of human development.

• **United Nations Development Programme (UNDP)**

• The UNDP is the United Nations' global development network, advocating for change and connecting countries to knowledge, experience, and resources to help people build a better life.

• It provides expert advice, training, and grants support to developing countries, with increasing emphasis on assistance to the least developed countries.

• The UNDP publishes the annual Human Development Report, which includes the Human Development Index (HDI) rankings.

• The organization's work is aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), aiming to eradicate poverty, reduce inequalities, and build resilience so that countries can sustain progress.

• **Life Expectancy at Birth**

• Life expectancy at birth is the average number of years a newborn is expected to live if current mortality rates continue to apply.

• This indicator provides an overview of the overall mortality level of a population, reflecting the quality of health services, living conditions, and other factors impacting life span.

• **Gross National Income (GNI) per capita**

• GNI per capita is the total domestic and foreign output claimed by residents of a country, divided by the population size.

• It includes gross domestic product (GDP) plus net income from abroad, such as earnings from foreign investments.

• This indicator is used to gauge the economic strength of a country and the average income of its residents.
